description.en: Multi-LLM chat workspace. Debate mode makes models argue and synthesize answers. Self-hosted, Docker, Ollama, streaming, auth and more.
description.zh: 多模型聊天工作区。辩论模式会让多个模型先互相讨论，再整理出答案。支持自托管、Docker、Ollama、流式输出和登录验证等功能。

description.en: Lightweight self-hosted server monitoring panel. Real-time metrics and 2FA security. Built because I needed something simple to keep an eye on my home server.
description.zh: 轻量级的自托管服务器监控面板，提供实时指标和双重身份验证。因为想找个简单的办法看一眼家里的服务器状态，所以干脆自己做了一个。

description.en: You're looking at it right now.
Web UI for managing PM2 processes. Start, stop, restart, and monitor Node.js apps from a browser instead of a terminal.
description.zh: 用网页管理 PM2 进程，可以直接启动、停止、重启和监控 Node.js 应用，不用再来回敲终端命令。

description.en: Voice assistant satellite for Home Assistant built on an ESP32-S3 with a microphone. Part of my home automation setup.
description.zh: 基于带麦克风的 ESP32-S3 做的 Home Assistant 语音卫星，是家里自动化系统的一部分。

description.en: DragonSea MC is a Forge-based city-building community. We're building a fully fictional nation and city with room for architects and explorers alike.
description.zh: 龙海是一个基于 Forge 的城市建设社区。我们正在一起创造一个完全虚构的国家和城市，不管你喜欢盖房子还是探索，都能找到适合自己的位置。

description.en: Aviation and railway photography platform built with React, Vite, and Node.js. It grew to more than 2,600 registered users and 23,800 photos before the website was discontinued.
description.zh: 使用 React、Vite 和 Node.js 构建的航空与铁路摄影平台。网站停止运营前拥有超过 2,600 名注册用户和 23,800 张照片。
